262     -
263     -/* ============================================================
264     -   1. GLOBAL OVERRIDES — Selection, scrollbar, focus
265     -   ============================================================ */
266     -
267     -html[data-theme="aurora"] ::selection {
268     -  background: var(--aurora-selection);
269     -  color: inherit;
270     -}
271     -
272     -html[data-theme="aurora"] :focus-visible {
273     -  outline: 2px solid var(--aurora-accent);
274     -  outline-offset: 2px;
275     -}
276     -
277     -html[data-theme="aurora"] :focus:not(:focus-visible) {
278     -  outline: none;
279     -}
280     -
281     -/* Cursor mandate for all interactive elements */
282     -html[data-theme="aurora"] button,
283     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [role="button"],
284     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"],
285     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"],
286     -html[data-theme="aurora"] a,
287     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-slot="collapsible-trigger"],
288     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-slot="tabs-trigger"],
289     -html[data-theme="aurora"] summary {
290     -  cursor: pointer;
291     -}
292     -
293     -
294     -/* ============================================================
295     -   2. BUTTONS — Completely redesigned with glow system
296     -   ============================================================ */
297     -
298     -/* All buttons get new radius + transition */
299     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"] {
300     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
301     -  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
302     -  font-weight: 500 !important;
303     -  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
304     -}
305     -
306     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-size="large"] {
307     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-lg) !important;
308     -  height: 36px !important;
309     -  padding: 6px 16px !important;
310     -}
311     -
312     -/* Primary — glowing CTA */
313     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="primary"],
314     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"][data-variant="primary"] {
315     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
316     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan) !important;
317     -  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
318     -}
319     -
320     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="primary"]:hover:not(:disabled),
321     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"][data-variant="primary"]:hover:not(:disabled) {
322     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan-hover) !important;
323     -  transform: translateY(-1px);
324     -  filter: brightness(1.08);
325     -}
326     -
327     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="primary"]:active:not(:disabled),
328     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"][data-variant="primary"]:active:not(:disabled) {
329     -  transform: scale(0.97) !important;
330     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan) !important;
331     -}
332     -
333     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="primary"]:focus-visible,
334     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"][data-variant="primary"]:focus-visible {
335     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan-focus) !important;
336     -}
337     -
338     -/* Secondary — glass with glow on hover */
339     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="secondary"] {
340     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
341     -  border: 1px solid var(--aurora-border) !important;
342     -  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
343     -  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
344     -  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
345     -}
346     -
347     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="secondary"]:hover:not(:disabled) {
348     -  border-color: var(--aurora-border-hover) !important;
349     -  box-shadow: 0 0 20px -6px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2) !important;
350     -  transform: translateY(-1px);
351     -}
352     -
353     -/* Ghost — subtle glass on hover */
354     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="ghost"] {
355     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
356     -  transition: all 0.2s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
357     -}
358     -
359     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="button"][data-variant="ghost"]:hover:not(:disabled) {
360     -  background: var(--aurora-card-bg-hover) !important;
361     -}
362     -
363     -/* Icon buttons */
364     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"] {
365     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
366     -  transition: all 0.2s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
367     -}
368     -
369     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="icon-button"][data-variant="ghost"]:hover:not(:disabled) {
370     -  background: var(--aurora-card-bg-hover) !important;
371     -}
372     -

374     -/* ============================================================
375     -   3. INPUTS — Glow focus rings, larger radius
376     -   ============================================================ */
377     -
378     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="text-field"] {
379     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
380     -  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
381     -}
382     -
383     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="text-field"]:focus-within {
384     -  border-color: var(--aurora-border-focus) !important;
385     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan-focus) !important;
386     -}
387     -
388     -html[data-theme="aurora"] input,
389     -html[data-theme="aurora"] textarea,
390     -html[data-theme="aurora"] select {
391     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-md) !important;
392     -  transition: border-color 0.25s var(--ease-aurora), box-shadow 0.25s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
393     -}
394     -
395     -html[data-theme="aurora"] input:focus,
396     -html[data-theme="aurora"] textarea:focus,
397     -html[data-theme="aurora"] select:focus {
398     -  box-shadow: var(--glow-cyan-focus) !important;
399     -  border-color: var(--aurora-border-focus) !important;
400     -}
401     -
402     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="inline-input"] {
403     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-sm) !important;
404     -}
405     -
406     -
407     -/* ============================================================
408     -   4. CARDS — Glassmorphism with glow hover
409     -   ============================================================ */
410     -
411     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="card"] {
412     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-lg) !important;
413     -  border: 1px solid var(--aurora-border) !important;
414     -  background: var(--aurora-card-bg) !important;
415     -  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
416     -  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
417     -  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-aurora) !important;
418     -}
419     -
420     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="card"]:hover {
421     -  border-color: var(--aurora-border-hover) !important;
422     -  box-shadow: var(--aurora-card-glow) !important;
423     -  transform: translateY(-2px);
424     -}
425     -
426     -
427     -/* ============================================================
428     -   5. DIALOGS — Frosted glass, glow borders, spring animation
429     -   ============================================================ */
430     -
431     -/* Backdrop — deeper blur */
432     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog-overlay"] {
433     -  background-color: rgba(5, 5, 10, 0.65) !important;
434     -  backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important;
435     -  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) !important;
436     -}
437     -
438     -/* Dialog panel — glass with aurora glow */
439     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"] [data-slot="dialog-content"] {
440     -  border-radius: var(--aurora-radius-xl) !important;
441     -  background: var(--aurora-glass-strong) !important;
442     -  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) !important;
443     -  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) !important;
444     -  box-shadow: var(--aurora-dialog-shadow) !important;
445     -  border: 1px solid var(--aurora-border) !important;
446     -}
447     -
448     -/* Dialog header — more spacing */
449     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"] [data-slot="dialog-header"] {
450     -  padding: 20px 24px !important;
451     -}
452     -
453     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"] [data-slot="dialog-title"] {
454     -  font-size: 17px !important;
455     -  font-weight: 600 !important;
456     -  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
457     -}
458     -
459     -/* Dialog body */
460     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"] [data-slot="dialog-body"] {
461     -  padding: 0 8px !important;
462     -}
463     -
464     -/* Spring-in animation override */
465     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"][data-transition] [data-slot="dialog-content"][data-expanded] {
466     -  animation: aurora-dialog-in 300ms var(--ease-snappy) !important;
467     -}
468     -
469     -html[data-theme="aurora"] [data-component="dialog"][data-transition] [data-slot="dialog-content"] {
470     -  animation: aurora-dialog-out 150ms ease-in forwards !important;
471     -}
472     -
473     -@keyframes aurora-dialog-in {
474     -  from {
475     -    opacity: 0;
476     -    transform: scale(0.92) translateY(8px);
477     -  }
478     -  to {
479     -    opacity: 1;
480     -    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
481     -  }
482     -}
483     -
484     -@keyframes aurora-dialog-out {
485     -  from {
486     -    opacity: 1;
487     -    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
488     -  }
